As a Grinding Operator, you will be responsible for the precision grinding and finishing of high-value metal components. Grinding is a critical step in the repair process, ensuring that parts are restored to their original manufacturer specifications.In this role, you will set up and operate CNC and/or conventional grinding machines to machine components with extremely tight tolerances, often within hundredths or even thousandths of a millimeter.
